  <title><![CDATA[Son of Iran's shah receives 'Freedom Prize' in Frankfurt]]></title>
  <updated>2026-11-07T14:38:00Z</updated>
  <published>2026-11-07T14:38:00Z</published>
  <rights>2026 DW</rights>
  <link rel="alternate" hreflang="en" href="https://www.dw.com/en/son-of-iran-s-shah-receives-freedom-prize-in-frankfurt/a-79885661?maca=en-rss-en-top-1022-xml-atom"/>
